name: Nador Corniche
hero_subtitle: The evening waterfront — cafés, lagoon views and the social heart of Nador.

overview.title: Where Nador comes out after dark
overview.p1: The corniche runs along the lagoon and has become the city’s social living room: families, cafés, soft light and a breeze off the water.
overview.p2: It is not monumental architecture; it is everyday Mediterranean town life. That is the value — orientation on day one and a place to return each evening.
overview.p3: Pair a corniche walk with seafood and a simple first look at Marchica before you plan longer outings.

food.title: Food on the Nador Corniche
food.p1: The corniche is the easiest place to eat with a lagoon view — seafood grills, cafés and simple evening tables as the promenade fills up.
food.li1: Seafood restaurants along the lagoon-facing stretch.
food.li2: Cafés for tea, juice and sunset watching.
food.li3: Grilled fish and salads for a light dinner.
food.li4: Busy tables are often a safer quality signal.
food.li5: Walk beyond the first row of cafés to compare options.
food.p2: Evenings are livelier than midday on the waterfront.

q1.question: Is it safe at night?
q1.answer: Stick to the main lit promenade; usual town precautions apply.

q2.question: Best section to walk?
q2.answer: Follow the lagoon-facing stretch where cafés cluster.

q3.question: Are there restaurants?
q3.answer: Seafood and cafés line parts of the walk — choose busy tables.

q4.question: Morning or evening?
q4.answer: Evening is when the place comes alive.

q5.question: Good with a stroller?
q5.answer: Much of the main promenade is relatively level.
